landing.tagline: Stop picking traffic lights. Pick your own images, audios, and challenges.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Three steps. One page of code.
landing.step1Body: Drag a folder into the dashboard, or fork one of the sample sets. Mark the images that count as correct.
landing.step2Body: Drop one script tag and one div into your page. Tie it to a puzzle with your site key.
landing.step3Body: POST the token and your secret key to /api/v0/captcha/siteverify.
landing.ctaSub: Drop in the widget, pick your images, ship.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data including sites, puzzles, image sets, and uploaded images.
deleteAccount.step2Title: Are you sure you want to do this?
deleteAccount.step2Body: This action is permanent and irreversible. All your sites, puzzles, image sets, and uploaded images will be permanently destroyed. Active CAPTCHA widgets on your sites will stop working immediately.
deleteAccount.step3Instruction: To verify, type your email <email></email> and the phrase <phrase></phrase> below.
deleteAccount.step4Body: This is your last chance. After this, there is no going back.
deleteAccount.step4Label: Enter your password to permanently delete your account
